claims.claim_text: Training segment (CDI brand) is a mandated recipient on a $5.7 billion IDIQ contract and a $1.9 million IDIQ contract with U.S. military.
claims.subject: AIRO/CDI/Coastal Defense International
claims.source_quote: we work closely with special military forces such as SEAL teams, the U.S. Naval Air Warfare Center, and USAF Air Combat Command, and are a mandated recipient on a $5.7 billion IDIQ contract and a $1.9 million IDIQ contract

claims.claim_text: Material weaknesses in ICFR identified for fiscal 2024 and 2025 and NOT remediated as of December 31, 2025; disclosure controls concluded NOT effective.
claims.subject: AIRO ICFR
claims.source_quote: our disclosure controls and procedures were not effective as of such date due to material weaknesses in internal control over financial reporting... these material weaknesses were not remediated and continued to be present as of December 31, 2025.

claims.claim_text: Two customers accounted for 79% of consolidated revenue in 2025, all in the Drone segment. European Drones revenue was $76.4M of $79.1M Drones segment.
claims.subject: AIRO customer concentration
claims.source_quote: For the year ended December 31, 2025, two customers accounted for 79% of our consolidated revenue, all of which related to Drone segment revenue.

claims.claim_text: Principal U.S. industrial facility at 23048 N. 15th Avenue, Phoenix, Arizona (29,353 sqft) supports U.S. drone manufacturing expansion and is core to Blue UAS certification path requiring U.S.-domiciled production.
claims.subject: AIRO Phoenix facility
claims.source_quote: an industrial facility located at 23048 N. 15th Avenue, Phoenix, Arizona 85027, consisting of approximately 29,353 rentable square feet, used to support U.S. operations and our efforts to expand our U.S. footprint for advanced drone innovation

claims.claim_text: Aspen Avionics serves as avionics supplier to OEMs including Robinson Helicopters, Pilatus, Honeywell, and Joby Aviation.
claims.subject: Aspen Avionics (AIRO subsidiary)
claims.source_quote: We also serve as an avionics supplier for OEMs, including Robinson Helicopters, Pilatus, Honeywell, and Joby Aviation.

claims.claim_text: AIRO is a rollup of multiple acquired entities (Sky-Watch, Coastal Defense, Aspen Avionics, Jaunt, Agile Defense, AIRO Drone) integrated under a four-segment platform thesis (Drones, Avionics, Training, Electric Air Mobility).
claims.subject: AIRO rollup thesis
claims.source_quote: We were organized in August 2021 for the purpose of acquiring and integrating various companies in the aerospace and defense industry... Our business is organized into four operating segments... Drones, Avionics, Training, and Electric Air Mobility.

kwargs.parent_thesis: Integrated aerospace and defense platform across Drones, Avionics, Training and Electric Air Mobility verticals with cross-segment synergies

claims.claim_text: AIRO is pursuing DoD Blue UAS certification expected to be completed by June 2026, contingent on U.S.-domiciled production. Without this, AIRO cannot sell drones to DoD.
claims.subject: AIRO Drones segment
claims.source_quote: We have expanded our U.S. manufacturing capabilities to support U.S. production of our military drones and are in the process of seeking DoD Blue UAS certification, which we currently estimate will be completed by June 2026 and will allow us to sell drones to the DoD.

claims.claim_text: Jaunt (Electric Air Mobility segment) has a patented compound rotorcraft configuration with over 300 piloted flight hours across multiple Jaunt demonstrator aircraft.
claims.subject: Jaunt / AIRO Group Holdings
claims.source_quote: Our aircraft integrate characteristics of both rotary- and fixed-wing platforms through our patented compound rotorcraft configuration, which has accumulated over 300 piloted flight hours

claims.claim_text: AIRO completed IPO June 2025 ($69M gross at $10) and Follow-on Offering (~$82.6M net) within fiscal 2025; Cantor Fitzgerald led both; insiders received equity at IPO close (Dangroup 546,173 shares, NGA 33,995 shares).
claims.subject: AIRO equity issuances
claims.source_quote: we registered and sold an aggregate of 6,900,000 shares of our common stock... at a price to the public of $10.00 per share, for aggregate gross proceeds of $69.0 million. The net proceeds to the Company from the IPO... were $58.3 million... $82,562 [thousand] Sale of common stock in Follow-on Offering
